# Disabled page-story controls

Original fixtures generated by `tools/inactive_stories_fixture.py`; no corpus
content, external assets, or third-party document engine is used.

All three sources contain default, first and even header references. The default
is plain text. First/even contain locked fields the engine does not support
(COMPARE since 2026-10-09; AUTHOR is now a retained, editable field type, so the
sources were regenerated). Locked fields show their cached result in the reference application either
way; the adjacent PDFs and `reference.json` hashes were captured from the
earlier AUTHOR sources. `disabled` explicitly disables both settings; `first` and `even`
enable their respective setting. The reference application exported the adjacent PDFs.
`reference.json` records source/PDF SHA-256 and extracted page text.

The reference application shows the default header on all three disabled pages. Enabling first or
even shows the corresponding retained field result only on that page. This
agrees with ECMA-376 Part 1 §§17.10.1 and 17.10.6, rather than demonstrating a
reference/spec divergence. Inheritance and shared-target cases are covered by unit
mutations of these original sources. Referenced package parts and relationships
still undergo structural validation; inactive contents remain unchanged.
